title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Ilaures in the Municipality of Bugasong, Province of Antique
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Ilaures in the Municipality of Bugasong, Province of Antique

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1743_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Ilaures is separated from the barrio of Camangahan, Municipality of Bugasong, Province of Antique, and constituted into a barrio in the said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Ilaures.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
